reviewScope.summary: Technical review of a two-file CI-only Playwright three-worker benchmark. Existing local single-worker behavior, full certification, strict failure policy, browser coverage, retry policy and production protection are preserved.
evidence: Source baseline: 8815bdc1fc3cf932ac921a610cf70a76d24f89aa; 290 E2E tests in 48.0 minutes with one worker in PR #50.
Reviewed Playwright default configuration and managed configuration inheritance; GitHub Actions CI=true selects 3 workers, local runs select 1.
Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript and targeted release architecture test executed on the isolated source candidate before evidence commit.
Adversarial assessment: simultaneous Chromium processes share the 4-vCPU/16-GB GitHub runner; browser contexts are isolated but external file/network resources might not be.
Full 290-test three-worker GitHub result has not occurred at review time; merge is contingent on ordinary authoritative Final candidate success.

adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted for a draft-PR benchmark only. Existing no-retry, max-one-failure and full-gate safeguards remain. Do not merge a failing or incomplete run.

adversarialFindings.description: Changing the original worker configuration would also increase local Windows browser processes.
